info.title: CTMS External API
info.description:
OpenAPI specification for the CRScube CTMS External API.

## Scope

The 14 endpoints whose paths begin with `/external/api/v1.1`.

| Tag | Count | Contents |
|-----|------:|----------|
| `sync` | 5 | Site, Subject, SAE, PD/PV and SDV synchronization (PUT) |
| `tracker` | 4 | SAE, PD/PV, Risk and Issue Tracker lookups |
| `project` | 3 | Study lookup, sponsor project list, team list |
| `mvr` | 2 | MVR list, MVR type codes |

## Authentication

The sync endpoints (5 PUTs) require the `X-API-Key` header.
Keys are issued per project; contact your CRScube representative for the value.

## How to read the status codes

**This API returns 400 even for unclassified errors.** In practice 500 does not
occur.

| Situation | Actual response |
|-----------|-----------------|
| Validation failure, body parse failure, any other error | **400** |
| X-API-Key missing, mismatched or not configured | 401 (`INVALID_REQUEST`) |
| No permission | 403 (`FORBIDDEN`) |
| Project, study or code not found | 404 (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) |

All three causes of 401 share the same `errorCode`, `INVALID_REQUEST`.
To distinguish them you must read `error.debugMessage`.

On the sync endpoints, a project that cannot be found produces **404 before the
API key is even checked**.

## Response format

Both success and failure always carry `status` and `responseLanguage`.

```
success  { result, message, status: "success", responseLanguage }
failure  { error: { errorCode, debugMessage, ...additional }, message,
           status: "fail", responseLanguage }
```

The 5 sync endpoints (PUT) return an empty object in `result`. They do not
report how many records were processed.

## Common to list endpoints

- `page` starts at 1. A value below 1 is corrected to 1.
- If `size` exceeds the server limit it is **silently** capped, without an error.
- The response `result` echoes the applied search conditions in
  `filteredElements`.
- Every row carries `deleted` and `no`.

servers.description: CTMS API host. Contact your CRScube representative for the address of each region and environment.

tags.name: sync
tags.description:
External system to CTMS data synchronization (PUT). **`X-API-Key` required.**
Each endpoint accepts at most 100 records per request, and the audit reason is
recorded as a system synchronization.

tags.name: tracker
tags.description: SAE, PD/PV, Risk and Issue Tracker lookups.

put.description:
Creates or updates the site (team) list of a project, up to 100 records per
call.

A `studyTeamKey` greater than 0 marks the team as already synchronized.
The audit reason is recorded as a system synchronization.

Creates or updates the subject list of a site, up to 100 records per call.

This is the only one of the five sync requests that validates each item
individually (including whether `screeningNo` is blank).

Creates or updates the SAE (serious adverse event) list of a subject,
up to 100 records per call.

Date fields accept partial or unknown date notations as strings.
A blank string is treated as null.
The `report` date, `comment` and `followUpCompleted` are forced to null by the
server.

Creates or updates the PD (protocol deviation) / PV list of a subject,
up to 100 records per call.

The server fixes the type to `SUBJECT` and treats `customValues` as an empty
list. A date string that fails to parse becomes null rather than raising an
error.

Creates or updates the SDV (source data verification) progress of a subject,
up to 100 records per call.

Unlike the other sync requests, `deleted` is the only required field on an item.

get.description:
Returns the SAE Tracker of a project, page by page.

The default sort is team name, then screening number, then report type, then
sequence, then follow-up number, all ascending.

Returns the PD/PV Tracker of a project, page by page.

`pdStatus` is a filter that accepts both code values and free-text entries.

The default sort is team ID ascending, then screening number ascending, then
input time descending, then key descending.

parameters.name: pdStatus
parameters.description: PD status filter. Accepts both code values and free-text entries.

parameters.name: pdpvTypes
parameters.description: PD/PV type filter. Multiple values allowed.

get.description:
Returns the Risk Tracker of a project, page by page.
The default sort is key descending.

Unlike the other trackers, there is no team-level filter (`teamKeys`).

Returns the Issue Tracker of a project, page by page.

`issueType` and `assigneeRole` are filters that accept both code values and
free-text entries.

The default sort is issue number descending, then key descending.

parameters.name: issueType
parameters.description: Issue type filter (code plus free-text pair).

parameters.name: assigneeRole
parameters.description: Assignee role filter (code plus free-text pair).

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Issue category filter (`TrackerIssueCategory`). Multiple values allowed.

get.summary: Look up a project by Study ID
get.description:
Looks up a CTMS project by the Study ID of the source system.

When there is no match the response is **404** (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), not
`result: null`.

Returns the projects belonging to a sponsor, page by page.

**Closed (CLOSED) projects are not returned.**

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Project status filter. Multiple values allowed.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Contact your CRScube representative for the available values.

get.description:
Returns the team (site) list of a project, page by page.
The default sort is `TEAM_ID_ASC`.

Unlike the other list endpoints, `result.additional` is always empty.

Returns the MVRs (Monitoring Visit Reports) of a project, page by page.

The default sort is team ID, then report number, then schedule key, all
ascending. Overdue determination follows the `overdueCondition` default,
`LAST_SIGN`.

`now` defaults to the server's current date and is used as the reference date
for the overdue calculation.

parameters.name: realTeam
parameters.description: Whether to return only real teams.

parameters.name: now
parameters.description: Reference date for the overdue calculation. Defaults to the server's current date.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order. The allowed values are —
`TEAM_ID_ASC`/`DESC`, `REPORT_NO_ASC`/`DESC`,
`PLANNED_DATE_ASC`/`DESC`, `CL_DATE_ASC`/`DESC`,
`FU_DATE_ASC`/`DESC`, `VISIT_DATE_ASC`/`DESC`,
`VISIT_COUNT_ASC`/`DESC`.

get.description:
Returns the MVR type codes used by a project.
They correspond to the `mvrType` values in the `/mvrs` response.

A project that cannot be found returns 404 (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`).

Although this is a list endpoint it is not paginated, so `result` is an array.

externalApiKey.name: X-API-Key
externalApiKey.description:
API key for the sync endpoints (PUT) only.
Keys are issued per project; contact your CRScube representative for the value.

ProjectId.name: projectId
ProjectId.description:
Project ID. On the sync endpoints (PUT) it also identifies the project whose
API key is registered.

StudySubjectKey.name: studySubjectKey
StudySubjectKey.description: Subject key in the source system (EDC).

StudyId.name: studyId
StudyId.description: Study ID in the source system.

ApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ApiKey.description:
API key for the sync endpoints (PUT) only.

Compared against the API key issued to the project.

- Header missing or blank: 401 (`INVALID_REQUEST`, "Missing X-API-Key header")
- No API key configured for the project: 401 ("API Key not configured for this study")
- Value mismatch: 401 ("Invalid API Key")

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number. Starts at 1; a value below 1 is corrected to 1.

Size.name: size
Size.description:
Rows per page. A value above the server limit is silently capped at the limit
(this is not an error).

SourceSystem.name: sourceSystem
SourceSystem.description: Source system. This is an enum binding, so an undefined value returns 400.

teamKeys.name: teamKeys
teamKeys.description: Team key filter. Leave it empty to query every team you can access.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Sort order. Contact your CRScube representative for the available values.

BadRequest.description:
Invalid request.

**This API returns 400 even for unclassified errors.**
As a result, 500 almost never occurs.

| errorCode | Cause |
|-----------|-------|
| `REQUIRED_PARAMETER` | Required value missing (`teamTempId`, `teamName`, `screeningNo`) |
| `INVALID_PARAMETER` | Body parse failure, enum binding failure, type mismatch |
| `INVALID_REQUEST` | Validation failure such as more than 100 records |
| `UNEXPECTED` | Unclassified exception |

The field that failed validation may be carried in `error.fieldName`.

error.debugMessage: Request list size must not exceed 100

value.message: Request list size must not exceed 100

Unauthorized.description:
API key verification failed. **This occurs only on the sync endpoints (PUT).**

All three cases share the `errorCode` `INVALID_REQUEST`, so `debugMessage` is
the only way to tell them apart.

| debugMessage | Cause |
|--------------|-------|
| `Missing X-API-Key header` | Header missing or blank |
| `API Key not configured for this study` | No API key configured for the project |
| `Invalid API Key` | Value mismatch |

Values are compared in a way that is safe against timing attacks.

Forbidden.description:
No permission.

This can occur when a lookup endpoint fails its permission check.

NotFound.description:
The target resource could not be found.

| Endpoint | Cause |
|----------|-------|
| All sync endpoints (PUT) | The given projectId is not registered |
| `GET /studies/{studyId}` | Study id or study not found |
| `GET /projects/{projectId}/mvr-types` | Project id not found |

On the sync endpoints, 404 is raised **before the API key is verified**. In
other words, calling with a wrong projectId returns 404 even if the API key is
also wrong.

_unit.description: Synchronization succeeded. `result` is an empty object and carries no record counts.

SuccessResponse.description:
Success response format.
`status` and `responseLanguage` are always present.

result.description: Endpoint-specific result. It is an empty object when the return type is `Unit`.

message.description: Defaults to the request-succeeded message rendered in `responseLanguage`.

FailResponse.description:
Failure response format.
The `error` map always contains `errorCode` and `debugMessage`, and when the
exception specifies a `fieldName` it is merged into the same map.

debugMessage.description: Raw message for developers. It is not localized.

fieldName.description: Name of the field that failed validation. Added only when a field can be identified.

message.description:
User-facing message rendered according to `responseLanguage`.
The wording may change, so do not branch on it.

PaginatedResult.description: List result. Carried verbatim in `result` of the response format.

contents.description: The rows returned. The row schema differs per endpoint.

isFiltered.description: Whether any filter condition was applied.

filteredElements.description:
Echoes back the search conditions that were applied.
The set of fields differs per endpoint.

PaginatedRow.description: The two fields common to every list row.

ErrorCode.description:
Error code. The values observed on this API are listed below.

| errorCode | HTTP | Where it occurs |
|-----------|-----:|-----------------|
| `INVALID_REQUEST` | 401 | X-API-Key missing or mismatched, API key not configured |
| `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Project, study or code lookup failed |
| `REQUIRED_PARAMETER` | 400 | Required value missing |
| `INVALID_PARAMETER` | 400 | Malformed parameter |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | No permission |
| `UNEXPECTED` | 400 | Unclassified exception |

Values not listed here may also appear. Branch on `error.errorCode` rather than
on the HTTP status.

ProjectExternalRetrieveResponse.description:
Project summary looked up by Study ID. Like a list row, it also carries
`deleted` and `no`.

When there is no match the response is 404 (`RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) —
`result` is not returned as null.

ProjectTeamDate.description: Project team dates. Every field is optional and holds a date string.

sites.description: Up to 100 records. More than that returns 400.

ExternalProjectTeamCreateRequest.description:
Site (team) create or update request.

The server fills `teamCode` from `teamTempId`, and `syncedTeam` is derived from
whether `studyTeamKey > 0`. Neither is a request field.

studyTeamKey.description: Team key in the source system. A value greater than 0 marks the team as synchronized.

reason.description: Audit reason. When omitted it is recorded as a system synchronization.

subjects.description: Up to 100 records. Each item is validated individually.

ExternalSaeSaveItem.description:
An SAE synchronization item.

Date fields accept partial or unknown date notations as strings.
A blank string is treated as null.
The `report` date, `comment` and `followUpCompleted` are forced to null by the
server.

startDate.description: Date string. Partial or unknown notations are allowed.

endDate.description: Date string. Partial or unknown notations are allowed.

received.description: Date string. Partial or unknown notations are allowed.

irb.description: IRB report date. Partial or unknown notations are allowed.

regulation.description: Regulatory authority report date. Partial or unknown notations are allowed.

ExternalPdpvSaveItem.description:
A PD/PV synchronization item. The server fixes the type (`type`) to `SUBJECT`
and treats `customValues` as an empty list.

A date string that fails to parse becomes null (it does not raise an error).

pdStatus.description: A code value or free-text entry.

visitLabel.description: Mapped to the `visit` field when stored.

ExternalSdvSaveItem.description:
An SDV synchronization item. Unlike the other sync requests, `deleted` is the
only required field; everything else defaults to null.

TrackerStatus.description:
Status values shared across the trackers. Pass them as a list in the `status`
query parameter.
Contact your CRScube representative for the allowed values.

TrackerPdType.description:
PD/PV type. The server fixes it to `SUBJECT` when storing through sync (PUT),
and you can filter on it with `pdpvTypes` when querying.

ExternalMvrPaginatedRow.description:
An MVR (Monitoring Visit Report) list row.

When `teamId` is present, `teamName` is returned combined as
`[teamId] teamName`.

teamName.description: When `teamId` is present it is combined as `[teamId] team name`.

mvrType.description: MVR type code. This is a code value returned by `/mvr-types`.

ExternalApprovalSignature.description:
An approval signature. `signedByDisplay` is a derived field, populated as
`"name (email)"` only when both `userName` and `userEmail` are present.

signedByDisplay.description: Populated only when both `userName` and `userEmail` are present.

MvrTypeCode.description: MVR type code. A code and label pair.
